description: The only way to give this round's answer when it is questions for the person. Fill the fields and call it; the platform builds and stores the answer from them. Do not write the answer as text.

parameters.summary: One line summarizing the decision the person must make.
parameters.questions: A non-empty array of strings; ask only the real product or authorization decisions the request leaves open. Do not invent authorization.
parameters.goalCardDrafts: Only when this request has no goal: optional drafts; a questions answer may carry drafts or none. Each draft is {objective, completion, autonomy, screening}: objective one sentence; completion a non-empty array of checkable completion criteria; autonomy "every_step" or "after_plan_confirmation"; screening is optional: omit it or use null when you did not screen the draft, otherwise {modules, size, conflictsWith, dependsOn, urgency, suggestedPosition, note} with bare moduleIds and goalIds for the platform to fill their refs; size is "small", "medium", "large" or "unknown", urgency is "high", "normal" or "low", suggestedPosition is null or an integer >= 0, note is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes. A draft is a proposal only.
